notes: Prerelease 3.0.0-beta.8 is a test version of Printer Bot 3.0 and it can have mistakes. It needs no new import. The hidden browser that draws receipts is put at rest between receipts and starts below normal priority, so a stream on the same PC comes first. A browser that was being replaced finishes no receipt any more, a few errors that could end Streamer.bot are caught, and a print queue on a network share is no longer read while a receipt prints. Reload the dock after the update.
